Subject: Post-call recap + timeboxed technical deep-dive (next steps)

Thanks again for the call this morning — great to learn more about StratusGSI's marketplace ingestion needs and the partner onboarding flow. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we keep momentum: 

Key takeaways:
- You want a partner-led demo focused on the marketplace provisioning flow and the webhook/event mapping (30–45 minutes).
- Primary success criteria: automated connector deploy, ability to pin model versions, and audit/logging visibility in the console.
- Stratus will provide an engineer (Marcus) to pair on the live integration.

Proposed next step: a timeboxed technical deep-dive (45 minutes) next week. We suggest an agenda:
1) 5 min intros & goal check
2) 20 min partner-led walkthrough of Stratus flow + integration questions
3) 15 min Redwood live demo of import/run + audit logs
4) 5 min action items & MAP alignment

Availability windows (Pacific):
- Tue 12/15: 09:00–11:00 or 15:00–16:30
- Wed 12/16: 11:00–13:00
- Thu 12/17: 08:30–10:00

Camila, would you be able to lead the Redwood demo portion and cover the audit/logging hooks? Ben — can you own sending the MAP draft after the call?

I attached the draft MAP and a link to the call recording from today for reference.

Thanks — Sergio
